resources.string: Connect to IHateMoney to share expenses. Changes are saved on this device, even when offline.
Add your IHateMoney project to start sharing expenses.
Join a Spliit group to share expenses, even offline. Participants and group settings are managed on the Spliit web app.
Paste the link shared from Spliit, or scan its QR code.
Enter a valid Spliit group link.
This expense cannot be edited here yet. Sync first, resolve any conflict, or edit advanced splits, recurring expenses and currency conversions on Spliit.
Spliit sync did not finish. Pending changes are kept on this device. Retry sync to check the server before uploading again.
Could not upload “%1$s”. Edit the expense and check its amount, title, and participants, then sync again. Other pending expenses were processed.
Use a title of 2–200 characters, notes up to 5000 characters, and a nonzero amount up to 10 million.

Both versions are kept until you choose. Changes to splits, attachments or other metadata also count as conflicts.

On this device:
%1$s

On Spliit:
%2$s

Keeping this device’s edit uses the latest Spliit metadata. Using Spliit discards the pending local change.
Expense no longer exists on Spliit.

The server may have saved this new expense without confirming it. Check Spliit first. Keep device edit retries creation and may create a duplicate on older servers. Use Spliit discards this pending copy and imports what is on the server.
The server version now uses an unsupported expense type. Keep your pending edit for reference and resolve it on Spliit, or use the server version.
This expense changed during editing. Your draft is still here; copy it before reopening the latest version.
Create, edit and delete evenly split expenses. Advanced splits, recurring expenses, currency conversions, participants and group settings are managed on Spliit.

On this device: %1$s
On Spliit: %2$s

Choose which name to keep.
Check this participant on Spliit before resolving the pending change.
Use a participant name of 2–50 characters.
This participant changed or is syncing. Refresh and try again.
Spliit may have created this participant without confirming it. Check the group on Spliit and sync again first. Retrying can create a duplicate.
Spliit has a participant named %1$s. The earlier creation could not be confirmed. Only link them if you have checked that they are the same person; local expense references will be kept.
